units.source_text: 日暮之后，大家又赴大殿礼拜。

en.t: After sunset, everyone went again to the main hall to worship.
The next day, they spent another whole day reciting prayers.

units.source_text: 秋风从遥远的山谷间吹来，寒气侵肤。

en.t: An autumn wind blew in from the distant valleys, and the cold pierced their skin.

units.source_text: 这几个多愁多感的人，心中连续不断地想起种种往事。

en.t: These sorrowful, sensitive people kept recalling all kinds of memories in their hearts.

units.source_text: 玉鬘一向自叹命苦，深恐难得出头之日。

en.t: Tamakazura had always lamented her hard fate and deeply feared that she would never have a day when she could rise in the world.

units.source_text: 但现在她听见右近在谈话中乘便说起：她父亲内大臣何等尊贵，对出身微贱的姬妾所生子女也都爱护周至。

en.t: But now she heard Ukon mention in conversation that her father, the Inner Minister, was an exalted man who showed thorough care even for children born to concubines of humble origin.

units.source_text: 便觉得她自己这墙阴小草一般的人，将来亦必有欣欣向荣之一日。

en.t: She therefore felt that even someone like herself, like a small blade of grass growing in the shadow of a wall, would surely one day flourish.

units.source_text: 离开长谷寺之日，两方互相问明京中住址。

en.t: On the day they left Hase Temple, the two parties asked each other clearly where they lived in the capital.

units.source_text: 右近深恐再度失却了这位小姐，颇不放心。

en.t: Ukon was deeply afraid of losing this young lady again and felt quite uneasy.

units.source_text: 右近家住六条院附近，玉鬘住在九条，相距不远。

en.t: Ukon lived near the Rokujo estate, while Tamakazura lived in Kujo, so the distance between them was not far.
If there was something they needed to discuss, it would also be very convenient.
The nurse and the others were thus relieved.
